task_definition.task_description: Please check my checking account balance first. Then, put a hold on one pair of black Sony XM5 headphones. Next, get my available coupons, figure out the best discount for the item, and submit the order using my credit card. After that, please analyze the text "Standard shipping requested.", and finally generate an invoice and send it to customer@example.com.

user_input.query: Hi, I’m user_12345. Could you start by checking my checking account balance? After that, I’d like to put a hold on one pair of black Sony XM5 headphones (product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk). Please look up my available coupons, including promo_code SAVE15, to determine the best discount for this purchase. Once you've found the best deal, go ahead and submit the order for the item in my items_list—specifically product_id p_sony_xm5_blk with a quantity of 1—using my credit_card as the payment_gateway. I also need you to analyze the text in my order_notes, which is "Standard shipping requested." Finally, please generate an invoice for this transaction and send it to my email at customer@example.com.
